identity_eligibility: Current released-GT matched candidate with exactly one correct immutable-birth identity in its actual shortlist; retain original EXISTING label. NO_MATCH requires a surviving known-birth identity outside the shortlist. Never fabricate NEW/IGNORE from absent correspondence.
assigned_update_eligibility: Only original rows with known current GT and known assigned immutable birth; independently match original yes/no to identity consistency and original IoU quality level>=2. Unknown assignments stay in the original model input with no invented target.
ambiguity: Multiple correct birth anchors in the actual shortlist are counted and excluded from this new identity subset; all original rows remain unchanged.
history: Original real source trajectories; no GT correction or native feature recapture. Report actual anchor-age seconds and filtered image exposure.
